name: Data
description: Look into the project's databases and try requests against its APIs. Every query and request Prism makes is listed, and anything that would change data waits for your yes.
agent: Databases and APIs: db_connections (the project's databases and their tables, or a schema), db_query (reading runs at once through a connection that cannot write; changes wait for the user's yes in the panel), api_request (GET at once; POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE to anywhere but this computer wait for the user's yes). Use them instead of ad-hoc scripts, so the user sees what you ran.

intro.tagline: Look inside databases and try out web requests.
intro.what: Many projects keep information in a database, or talk to other services over the web. This lets you look at the tables in a database and ask it questions, and send test requests to a web service to see what comes back. It also shows you everything Prism looks at or sends.
helps: Anything that would change or delete data waits for your yes.
You can see every query and request Prism made.
intro.example: Prism wants to fix a bug in your shop app. It looks at the orders table, and when it wants to delete a test order, a box pops up asking you first.
